claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, targeting plateau pressure <30 cmH2O and appropriate oxygenation.
Continue sedation with lorazepam as ordered, titrating to goal RASS -1 to -2, and monitor sedation level.
Monitor CIWA-Ar scores and manage alcohol withdrawal symptoms with lorazepam as needed.
Continue levetiracetam 1000 mg IV for seizure prophylaxis and monitor phenytoin level (6.5 ug/mL) if applicable.
Monitor blood glucose every 6 hours and administer insulin sliding scale as ordered to maintain glucose 70-100 mg/dL.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, phosphate) and replace as needed to maintain normal levels.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment to evaluate readiness for extubation.
Continue D5 1/2NS at 75 mL/hour for maintenance fluids and monitor fluid balance.
Monitor vital signs and oxygen saturation continuously, with alarms set appropriately.
Perform oral care and subglottal suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
